research_question: Can a known-coordinate diffeomorphic transport wrapper preserve the frozen 2A+2AT observation-only warm-start accuracy envelope on composed coordinate maps that were never used to fit the predictor, while missing and wrong transport controls fail on the same cells?
scientific_role: post-open Case6 coordinate-equivariance mechanism gate; not a new physical-flow deformation experiment, external dataset test, resource gate, curved-ray result, arbitrary-diffeomorphism theorem, or real-BOST result

parent_evidence.v102_limit: No rank4 arm established paired advantage over the static rank0 prior; v110 must preserve that negative result unless the preregistered coordinate stress changes the paired ordering.
parent_evidence.v109_limit: Only one-axis plus/minus maps at absolute amplitude 0.08 and five already-open Case6 frames were tested; no warm initializer or heldout coordinate composition was tested.

coordinate_interpretation.meaning: Each map is a change of spatial chart. The scalar field and camera operator are conjugated together through the known map; it is not presented as a new physical flame realization.
coordinate_interpretation.reference_domain_algorithm: Run the already-sealed observation-only predictor and strict K1 refinement in the canonical reference chart, then push the reconstructed scalar through the known diffeomorphism.
coordinate_interpretation.covariant_observation: Score a transformed field with A_phi = A_ref composed with the declared pullback to the reference chart.

heldout_composed_diffeomorphisms.component_family: the frozen boundary-preserving one-axis analytic map from v103
heldout_composed_diffeomorphisms.composition_order: components are listed in reference-to-physical order; scalar pushforward evaluates inverse components in the mathematically required reverse-coordinate composition

continuous_transport.coarse_to_fine_lift: separable linear interpolation on the exact nested grid, followed once by the v109 one-coarse-interval half-cosine support window
continuous_transport.scalar_pushforward: compose bounded-memory trilinear gathers at inverse map coordinates without transformed-frame remasking or regauging
continuous_transport.scalar_pullback_for_scoring: apply the true forward map sequence in reverse component order; score field and gradients in the common reference chart, which is the Jacobian-consistent coordinate-invariant metric rather than an ordinary L2 on deformed voxel indices
continuous_transport.scalar_pullback_for_observation: after the same true pullback, restrict by exact stride, apply the common coarse support-zero-mean gauge, and evaluate the frozen reference camera operator
continuous_transport.truth_reference: source-informed full-resolution density resampled directly to the 8x nested grid, plateau-gauged and windowed once before transport

learned_advantage_gate.role: separate from coordinate-mechanism validity; a transport pass cannot erase the frozen v102 simple-baseline result
learned_advantage_gate.if_failed: Keep the analytic coordinate wrapper but close the RBF predictor as a novelty claim; do not authorize a larger neural model to rescue it on Case6.

cost_accounting.v102_fold_geometry_reference_projection_: 5A for one fold-geometry pair: A(mean) plus A of four reference modes; report separately and amortize only across an explicitly stated batch

independent_validation.independent_lift: separately implemented exact-nested separable interpolation and half-cosine support
independent_validation.independent_composition: manual composed coordinate evaluation with fixed-iteration bisection inverses and independent bounded-memory eight-corner gather
validator_must_recompute: v102 and v109 parent terminal identities
all selected parent fields and exact-call receipts
all composed-map Jacobian and inverse diagnostics
all truth and candidate lifts, correct/identity/wrong transports, pullbacks, and coordinate-covariant observations
all 630 rows, eight-gate decisions, paired controls, ledgers, summaries, and final decision
formal inputs and outputs remained byte-identical

decision.mechanism_pass_requires: every numerical-integrity, primary matched-accuracy, exact-call, and correct-versus-missing/wrong transport predicate
decision.if_mechanism_pass_and_learned_advantage_: Freeze a minimal CPU coordinate-conditioned MLP sentinel on a separate fit-only roster, preserving the same analytic transport wrapper and simple controls.
Retain the analytic equivariant wrapper as a structural component, keep projected-ridge or rank0 as the honest candidate, and do not train a larger network on Case6.
decision.if_mechanism_fail: Close this composed trilinear-lift wrapper and move to a continuous coefficient or mesh-aware operator before any neural training.

claim_limits: A pass supports only a known-map coordinate-equivariant warm-start mechanism on five already-open Case6 frames and six preregistered composed maps.
The independent physical sample count is five, not ninety or six hundred thirty.
The maps are coordinate charts, not six new flame realizations or fixed-camera physical deformations; all physical scoring is performed after pullback to the common reference chart.
The composed maps are held out from predictor fitting but the physical Case6 truth is post-open development data.
The formal process may read already-open truth for post-seal scoring, so API-level target noninterference may be shown but process-level never-read is not claimed.

No arbitrary diffeomorphism, unknown registration, external physical generalization, wall-time speedup, memory advantage, neural-operator superiority, curved-ray, first, unique, state-of-the-art, real-BOST, or paper-success claim is allowed.
